name: AspectRatio
description: A box that keeps a fixed width to height ratio for what it holds, such as an image, a video or a map. It reserves the space before the content loads, so the page does not jump.

ratio.description: Width divided by height as a number (1.5), a "16/9" string, or a preset: square 1/1, video 16/9, photo 3/2, wide 21/9, portrait 3/4.

rounded.description: Rounds the corners with the control radius.

children.description: The content. Images, video and iframes are stretched to fill the box and cropped to cover it.

keyboard: Not interactive: it adds no tab stops
requirements: The box adds no role or name; the content inside carries its own, such as alt text on an image
Content that is cropped must not lose information that matters: pick a ratio that fits it
screenReader: Transparent to screen readers; only the content inside is announced

use_when: Media whose size is not known before it loads
A grid of tiles that must line up
A video or map embed that should scale with its container
avoid_when: Text content: it can overflow the fixed box
Content that must never be cropped, such as a chart with labels at the edges
anti_patterns: Putting long text inside, which gets clipped
Setting a height on the box, which fights the ratio
